source_refs.note: 10. Identifying barriers to care: a main subheading of 22.1.2 Applications of Biostatistics, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 189-189.

blocks.text: Biostatistics also uncovers barriers to healthcare access by analyzing survey data and health service usage patterns. This insight helps healthcare providers and policymakers develop strategies to improve access and reduce health disparities, making healthcare systems more efficient and equitable.
